description:
Detects account creation events bypassing approval workflows

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg01_018", "data__json.rEventName" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'AuditEvents' AND "data__json.rEventName" IN ('ProvisionAutonomousDatabase', 'AdvanceAutonomousDatabase') AND "value" > 0
